messages:
cust-901: Hey team — heads up, our semantic search stopped working after we pinned our model yesterday. Embeddings coming back as length 1024 but our index expects 1536.
kelly_support: Sorry to hear that — can you paste the exact model id you pinned and a sample request/response?
cust-901: model=redwood-embed-large:2026-03-15-pin. Sample response: {
  \"embedding\": [/* 1024 floats */],
  \"model\": \"redwood-embed-large\"
}
kelly_support: Thanks. Two quick questions: did you pin to a specific variant or to a version tag? Any chance a canary slipped in?
cust-901: We used the console UI to pin the variant called \"large:quant-v2\" — we thought it was the same as prod. No canary that we know of.
ingrid_engineer: tagging in eng-ml. The vecsize change sounds like a variant substitution (quantized vs float). Can you also share the request headers and the request body (no PII)?
cust-901: Request is standard: POST /v1/embeddings { \"model\": \"redwood-embed-large\", \"input\": [\"...\"] } Headers include x-redwood-variant: large:quant-v2 and authorization token.
ingrid_engineer: ok. Can you run a quick curl against the unpinned model id to compare? e.g.
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"redwood-embed-large","input":["test"]}' | jq '.embedding | length'
```
That will show reported vector length.
matt_eng_ml: Also check the model catalog entry for the pinned tag — sometimes pinning a tag that points to a quantized variant will change output dims if we had variant aliases. I'll look up the pin mapping.
deploy-bot: deploy log: variant large:quant-v2 -> backend node pool pinned at 2026-03-15T18:22:03Z (user: console.kelly).
ingrid_engineer: I can reproduce locally: `redwood-embed-large:quant-v2` returns length 1024, `redwood-embed-large:float-v1` returns 1536. Looks like the pin resolved to the quantized family.
kelly_support: For a short-term fix, we can unpin or re-pin to the float variant. Would you like us to roll back the pin to float-v1?
cust-901: Yes please, rolling back sounds safest. We don't want to change index or retrain.
matt_eng_ml: Creating an internal rollback ticket and a change to documentation to warn about vecsize differences between quantized and float variants.
ingrid_engineer: Performed rollback: re-pinned model tag to `redwood-embed-large:float-v1`.
deploy-bot: config change applied; propagation confirmed to 12/12 nodes.
cust-901: Confirmed — embeddings now show length 1536 and search latencies back to normal. Thank you! :white_check_mark:
kelly_support: Glad that fixed it. We'll follow up with a postmortem note and suggested console UI warning when pinning variants with differing output dims.
kelly_support: Added follow-up ticket: TICKET-1428 (pin-warning-and-validation).
ingrid_engineer: Closing loop with eng-ml to add a server-side validation check to refuse pins that change vec length for customers with existing indexed datasets.
matt_eng_ml: Noted. Thanks everyone for quick turnaround.
kelly_support: Marking thread resolved. :thumbsup:
